title: Frog Jump
description: Determine if a frog can cross a river by jumping on stones with variable jump sizes.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize map stone_jumps {stone_pos: set of jump_sizes}
2. stone_jumps[0] = {0}
3. For each stone in stones:
4.   For each k in stone_jumps[stone]:
5.     For jump in {k-1, k, k+1}:
6.       If stone + jump exists in stones and jump > 0:
7.         Add jump to stone_jumps[stone + jump]

steps.note: Initialize starting position at index 0 with jump 0.
At stone 0, frog makes first jump of 1 unit to reach stone 1.
At stone 1 (k=1), possible jumps are 0, 1, 2. Jump 2 reaches stone 3.
At stone 3 (k=2), possible jumps are 1, 2, 3. Jump 2 reaches stone 5.
At stone 5 (k=2), possible jumps are 1, 2, 3. Jump 1 reaches stone 6.
At stone 6 (k=1), possible jumps are 0, 1, 2. Jump 2 reaches stone 8.
At stone 8 (k=2), possible jumps are 1, 2, 3. Jump 4 reaches stone 12.
At stone 12 (k=4), possible jumps are 3, 4, 5. Jump 5 reaches stone 17 (Target).
